sense.text:
“Likewise, ye husbands, dwell with them according to knowledge.” Brothers that are married have to deal with their wives according to knowledge, and that knowledge is the knowledge of the scriptures.

“giving honour unto the wife, as unto the weaker vessel.” The honour given to the wife is understanding that she is weaker than you. God created the woman as the weaker vessel. In the body, men have muscles and are built different; a woman is soft and tender and delicate and cannot lift heavy things the way men can. And she is weaker in mind too: a woman works on her emotions. Her weakness is her emotions, and she is easily manipulated. Satan manipulated Eve, and Eve manipulated Adam. So it is the man’s job to protect her, to rule over her, to guide her, to build her up, and when Satan jumps on her, to guide her and correct her. Something happens and she bugs out like it is the end of the world; you tell her, relax, it’s going to be okay.

The problem with some men is that they put their wife on the same level as themselves and expect her to think like them. Some sisters will get offended and say, I’m equal to my man. No, you are not. Sisters, you have to learn to control your emotions, because your emotions make you say and do things that are not right.

“and as being heirs together of the grace of life.” Husband and wife are working together to get the kingdom of heaven. He is not working by himself, and she is not working by herself.

“that your prayers be not hindered.” Many married couples pray to God and he does not listen, because they are not dealing right with each other. If husband and wife are not on one accord, God is not going to hear their prayers. He looks at how they are dealing with each other and asks, why am I listening to you?

“Finally, be ye all of one mind.” The husband and the wife must be of one mind.

“having compassion one of another.” Brothers, when your woman says or does something dumb, you have to show compassion: she just don’t know. “love as brethren”: love her like a friend, like a brethren.

“be pitiful, be courteous.” Courteous means being polite, respectful and kind. In the marriage, husband and wife must be polite, respectful and kind to each other, and many in their marriages are not.

Respect means, sisters, you must respect your husband. The scripture refers to your husband as your lord. He is your lord and your head, and the man’s head is Christ. Whatever you would not say to Christ, you should not say to your husband. Would you talk back to Christ? Then do not do it to your husband.

“Not rendering evil for evil, or railing for railing.” This goes into strife and arguments. Your wife says something evil to you, and you say something evil back, tit for tat. The two of you are in the house cursing each other out, and the children see all of it. Then you come in on Saturday saying shalom with a low bow, while all week you curse each other out nasty.

Brothers, do not argue with your woman. Does Christ argue with us? No. So why the hell are you arguing with your woman? Men of God don’t roll like that: you tell her what it is, and that’s it. When husband and wife go back and forth rendering evil for evil and railing for railing, that is Satan in the mix of that marriage. And it affects the kids: they grow up thinking that is okay, and it is not okay. You say you are serving God, but you have to learn how to fight Satan when you serve God. If your wife says something evil, check her and keep it moving. Why let her pull you out of the spirit to say evil back? Sisters, learn to control your damn emotions and stop throwing tantrums in your house.

“but contrariwise blessing.” It must be the contrary: bless each other. When the wife gets up in the morning she is supposed to bless her husband: Christ bless you, my king, my lord. That helps her see him as who he really is. The Israelite men that repented are the sons of God; if she admires her husband and sees him as who God says he is, she will bless him every morning.

“knowing that ye are thereunto called, that ye should inherit a blessing.” The husband and the wife are both called to inherit that blessing, and to get it they have to deal right with each other, work with each other and love each other. Satan will come to test your marriage, whispering in your ear, he don’t love you anymore, he don’t show you affection. Sister, stop listening to Satan. Learn to spot him and shake him off.

“For he that will love life, and see good days.” If you want the kingdom of heaven, love life and want good days, “let him refrain his tongue from evil.” The evil here is husband and wife speaking evil to each other. Control your damn mouth. Stop saying hurtful things to your spouse.

This is happening among the brothers and sisters, and if the word of God can’t change you, why are you here? Keep dealing with each other wrong and you will have to watch online. “and his lips that they speak no guile.”

“Let him eschew evil, and do good”: hate evil, and do good to each other.

“let him seek peace, and ensue it.” Some sisters sit in the house for days with a damn attitude and won’t say what is bothering them. The Bible says seek peace. Men are not mind readers, not Professor X. If your husband did something that hurt you, come to him and say, you did this to me and it hurt me. He will say, my bad, I didn’t mean it, or tell you why he did it, and at least it is out of the way, instead of walking around secretly mad and expecting him to read your mind. We must seek peace with our spouse.

“For the eyes of the Lord are over the righteous.” This is why: God is watching how you deal with each other. A brother is not going to deal evil with his wife, because God is watching him and will judge him, and it should be the same with the sisters. Judgment is going to come to your black behind if you keep dealing evil with your husband, running your damn mouth and being disrespectful. God sees you.

“and his ears are open unto their prayers.” “but the face of the Lord is against them that do evil.” Deal evil with each other and the Lord is against you. Do not be in the house calling each other names and fooling yourselves that you are serving God. Stop arguing and saying hurtful things to each other in front of your kids.

“Hide me from the secret counsel of the wicked.” There is no such thing as, oh, that’s a conspiracy. There is a secret counsel of the wicked, and the wicked here is white people. White people have set up secret counsel to destroy the people of God, to destroy blacks and Hispanics worldwide. They do things in secret thinking nobody will know, but we know.

The wicked is not Tyrone on the corner that robbed you last week. It is the people destroying the earth, the people that conquered nations, the genocidal maniacs that murdered millions on this earth, the people that unleashed COVID-19 and killed millions, experimenting with bat disease and creating diseases to annihilate. That’s the wicked.

And after all that has been shown of how the pharmaceutical companies got rid of the natural remedies that could heal you, anyone who still thinks the white man is not evil and has nothing set up to destroy us has something wrong with them.

“Who whet their tongue like a sword, and bend their bows to shoot their arrows, even bitter words: that they may shoot in secret at the perfect.” They shoot in secret at the perfect: they are trying to destroy us. And one of the ways they do it in secret is through the food and the medical industry, the food and drug administration, the FDA.

precepts.why:
To explain who the wicked are: “The earth is given into the hand of the wicked: he covereth the faces of the judges thereof.” Who is ruling the earth today? Esau. He is the one ruling. He is the wicked. The white man is the wicked.

So the secret counsel of the wicked in Psalms 64 is the secret counsel of those who rule the earth today.

“Keep not thou silence, O God: hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God. For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult.” God has enemies, and God’s enemies are the wicked, all nations. They make a tumult, a loud gathering. “and they that hate thee have lifted up the head”: they that hate God are ruling the earth today.

“They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones.” That crafty counsel goes into many different things they have set up to destroy us as a people. The educational system is crafty counsel. Religious systems are crafty counsel. And the medical system and the food system were also set up to destroy us: the FDA.

“They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.” They want to cut us off; they want to kill us. They have been massacring us for hundreds of years: millions of North American Indians killed over here to this day, millions of Taino Indians and Puerto Ricans, millions of us in Africa. They did it through colonization, through slavery and through murders, and they are doing it also through the food and through the medical industry, through the food and drug administration.

“Moreover, the nations in their wicked conspiracy.” The nations have wicked conspiracies, and one of those wicked conspiracies is to destroy us, to wipe out the people of God, the sons of God, the Israelites.

They call you a conspiracy theorist when you speak the truth so nobody will listen to you. But the scripture says the nations have their wicked conspiracy, and the conspiracy theorists keep being proven right.

“Thou wentest forth for the salvation of thy people, even for salvation with thine anointed.” Always remember the key words. Who is the Lord’s people? Israel, the children of the slave trade. That is why Christ is coming back: for the salvation of his people.

“thou woundedst the head out of the house of the wicked.” The house of the wicked is America and Europe; it is white people, and the Lord is going to destroy them. That’s Bible prophecy. Some squint at that and say, but I love white people; they have been indoctrinated in white lies. “by discovering the foundation unto the neck. Selah”: he is going to cut their heads off; there will be no head left. All praises to God.

“Thou didst strike through with his staves the head of his villages”: his countries. “they came out as a whirlwind to scatter me”: the white men will come out to fight against Christ when he returns.

“their rejoicing was as to devour the poor secretly.” Their rejoicing was to destroy the poor secretly. They are trying to destroy us secretly to this day, and that goes into their medicine, their food and drug administration, all of it. The Lord is letting us know there is secret counsel to destroy us, to kill us.

sense.text:
“And the Lord God formed man of the dust of the ground.” We were created from the dust of the ground, from the earth. That is how God created us.

Because we are from the earth, everything the earth has in it, iron, zinc, copper, magnesium, is in our body, and we need those things for our body to be healthy. The minerals are metals in the earth; the trees and plants take those minerals out of the soil, the minerals go into the food, and when we eat that food we get them, and they sustain us and nourish us. Lack them and the body cannot fight sickness or heal itself. When the doctor says you are deficient in iron, remember: God made us from the earth.

precepts.why:
“Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful. But his delight is in the law of the Lord; and in his law doth he meditate day and night. And he shall be like a tree.”

We came from the ground, and the scripture says we shall be like a tree. Everything is symbolic; there is a reason God refers to us as trees. “planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither.” A tree whose leaves wither and that bears no fruit is an unhealthy tree; it withers and fades away.

It is the same for us as human beings that God created from the earth. A tree needs water, it needs sun, and it needs nourishment from the earth. The tree takes its nourishment from the earth the same way we take our nourishment from the earth.

Isaiah also speaks of us as trees: “To appoint unto them that mourn in Zion, to give unto them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness; that they might be called trees of righteousness.”

The Lord calls us trees of righteousness. With Psalms 1, where the leaves of those trees do not wither, it shows those trees are healthy and nourished, as we are meant to be, drawing our nourishment from the earth we were made from.

sense.text:
This goes to the diet. “And God said, Behold, I have given you every herb bearing seed, which is upon the face of all the earth, and every tree, in the which is the fruit of a tree yielding seed.” Every tree yielding seed. Today Esau takes the seeds out of the fruits, and we are not supposed to eat that.

“to you it shall be for meat.” This is a holistic diet, an alkaline diet. The meat here is not animal meat: the Hebrew word translated meat means food or nourishment. Nourishment is what provides what is needed for someone to be healthy and to grow and develop. So the food God gave us to eat nourishes us and makes us healthy.

That is how we ate in Genesis: greens and herbs, food that is not acidic or toxic like beef and chicken. In an alkaline body, eating fruits and vegetables, diseases cannot survive, because the body kills them. Alfredo Bowman, Dr. Sebi, healed people with natural herbs on that understanding, and when the government came for him, he beat the government in court.

But the food in Babylon has no minerals. The farmers here have used the same fertilizer for a hundred years, and it only takes five to ten years to deplete the minerals out of the soil. The Most High gave a law for that: you cannot farm the land ten years straight; the land has to rest, and the crops grow and fall back on the ground and refertilize the earth. Today it takes twenty-three tomatoes to get the nutrients of one tomato from years ago, and Russia and Europe will not eat American food. So when the scripture says these are given for meat, for nourishment, we are supposed to be eating food with minerals in it, because those minerals are in our flesh and in our cells.

So take what the food no longer gives you: vitamin D3 if you are not out in the sun, because it is harder for us to absorb with the pigment in our skin; magnesium every day; zinc; drink your water from a copper cup. Go to your doctor, get blood work and see what you are lacking. Herbs and proper nutrition do not just go in and cure the sickness; they strengthen the body, and it is your body, with millions of warrior cells, that fights the sickness. Without that nourishment you get sick. That is how they are assassinating us with their food and their drugs.

precepts.why:
“He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle, and herb for the service of man.” God gave herbs for the service of man.

So what the hell are the Rockefellers talking about, calling herbs quackery and saying we shouldn’t use them? God says he gave the herbs for our service, for us to use to keep our body functioning and nourished. When Rockefeller funded the Flexner report in 1910, natural healing was labelled unscientific, the herbal schools and nearly all the black medical schools were shut down, and synthetic drugs made from petroleum were made the standard, drugs that could be patented and that treat sickness without healing it, to make lifelong customers. But the herbs were given by God for the service of man.

“In the midst of the street of it, and on either side of the river, was there the tree of life, which bare twelve manner of fruits, and yielded her fruit every month: and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.”

This is going into something spiritual: it is the kingdom of heaven that John the revelator saw, and we know the Lord heals us through the word of God. But it is given as an analogy of something real, and the physical side shows the importance of herbs. Why does it say the leaves of the tree are for healing? Because the leaves of many trees on the earth literally heal you.

Soursop leaves kill cancer cells. We all have small amounts of cancer cells in us; it is when they overgrow. Get up in the morning, boil some soursop leaf, some lime leaf, some cloves, and drink a cup of tea: that alone helps kill cancer cells and keeps you from getting sick. In the islands we went outside, picked the herbs, made tea and drank it every day, and never went to the doctor except for a broken hand. They don’t teach this anymore. Don’t wait until you are sick; start now and keep it under control. And the leaves are not talking about ganja; they are for medication and healing.

sense.text: “And now art thou cursed from the earth, which hath opened her mouth to receive thy brother’s blood from thy hand.” This is when Cain killed his brother Abel, and it shows one of the curses God gave the white men. This curse is for white people today.

“When thou tillest the ground, it shall not henceforth yield unto thee her strength.” When he farms, the earth will not yield her strength, and the strength the earth is supposed to yield is the minerals, the iron in the soil.

So God says when the white men farm, the earth is not going to yield its minerals. That is why the food grown today has no minerals in it: it is a curse God put on the white men, that murderous genocidal race of people. The earth says, I ain’t giving you no minerals, you murderer. So they pour all types of fertilizer on the crops to force it, and that fertilizer comes from oil too. The earth does not yield its strength to the white man when he farms, so there are no nutrients in the food, and that is why so many of us are getting sick.

“Take thou also unto thee wheat, and barley, and beans, and lentiles, and millet, and fitches, and put them in one vessel, and make thee bread thereof”: put it all in one bowl and make bread, “according to the number of the days that thou shalt lie upon thy side, three hundred and ninety days shalt thou eat thereof.”
“And thou shalt eat it as barley cakes, and thou shalt bake it with dung that cometh out of man, in their sight.” Bake the bread with human dung, in everybody’s sight.

“And the Lord said, Even thus shall the children of Israel eat their defiled bread among the Gentiles.” The same way you bake the bread with human shit, that is how the children of Israel are going to eat their defiled bread among the Gentiles.

That was a prophecy for today. God told Ezekiel to make bread with human dung in front of everybody to show how they would eat their food in the future, enslaved and scattered among the Gentiles. The food we eat is defiled: chemicals in the food that give you cancer, pesticides sprayed on it, no nutrients in it. God prophesied us eating all the filth we eat today that gets us sick.

And who is behind it all? The wicked, the white man. Now he is cloning everything and feeding us lab-grown milk and lab-grown meat. The food and the drug work hand in hand: the food has no nutrients and gets you sick, then they create the drug to treat the sickness, and then they kill you. That is how they kill us.
“And when he had opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth beast say, Come and see.” This goes into diseases.

“And I looked, and behold a pale horse: and his name that sat on him was Death, and Hell followed with him.” This pale horse is America: death, and hell following with him.

“And power was given unto them over the fourth part of the earth.” The fourth part of the earth is the western hemisphere, and who has power over the western hemisphere? America. “to kill with sword”: through war. “and with hunger”: famine. “and with death.”

“and with the beasts of the earth.” That is zoonosis: the diseases that animals carry, like COVID-19, that Esau took and made so humans could contract them, and turned into a bioweapon. That is gain-of-function research, genetically altering an organism to make it more virulent and more transmissible. That is the killing with the beasts of the earth.

precepts.why:
“Thou shalt not be joined with them in burial, because thou hast destroyed thy land, and slain thy people.” This is talking about America. They destroyed their land, there will be civil war here, and they have slain their own people.

It is not only civil war: America literally killed its own citizens through the coronavirus that was let loose on the earth. The government was behind it, Fauci and higher-ups behind him. The coronavirus killed millions all over the world, and millions are still dying from being injected with that vaccination. Many were forced to take it or lose their jobs. They are getting turbo cancer, heart failure, extreme blood clots, myocarditis; the mRNA has been found in the heart. The whole world was led like sheep to the slaughter. And Fauci was pardoned: what does he need a pardon for if he did nothing wrong? Nobody can be sued, and our people have to deal with the sickness.

“the seed of evildoers shall never be renowned.” Through the diseases they release and through the food and drug assassination, they are killing us and killing their own people too, just to get rich.

The solutions: those who took the shot should go to the doctor, get the heart screened and check the blood for the spike protein. Zinc, dandelion tea and white pine needle tea help stop it. Fast, a two or three day fast, because fasting makes the body consume and cast out what is not supposed to be there. Detox, sweat, take detox baths, see a certified holistic doctor for herbs to cleanse the blood, and take your minerals.

sense.text: “But ye are forgers of lies, ye are all physicians of no value.” The white man’s physicians are physicians of no value: the things they give you are to treat your sickness, not to cure you.

“And Asa in the thirty and ninth year of his reign was diseased in his feet, until his disease was exceeding great: yet in his disease he sought not to the Lord, but to the physicians.”

Who must you seek first and foremost when you are sick? The Lord, not the physician. Asa did not go to the Lord; he went to the physicians first.

“Purge me with hyssop.” Brothers and sisters need to do a purge. In the islands, every three months we do a purge to get the parasites out. Hyssop is an herb, a good herb for cleansing; get it in your house and bathe with it.

“and I shall be clean.” Our forefathers used hyssop to cleanse themselves, which shows we can use herbs to cleanse the body. The vegetables you eat thinking you are eating healthy have all types of things in them that cause cancer, so every two or three months do a body cleanse with a holistic doctor and herbs, and get the parasites and the toxins out of your body.
“Honour a physician with the honour due unto him for the uses which ye may have of him: for the Lord hath created him.” God created the physician.
“For of the most High cometh healing.” That is where healing first and foremost comes from: the Most High God. “and he shall receive honour of the king.”

“The Lord hath created medicines out of the earth.” Where did God create medicine? Out of the earth. Did it say from petroleum? Out of the earth. So what the hell are these white people talking about, herbal medicine is quackery? Medicine comes from the earth, from the plants, from the food we eat.

“and he that is wise will not abhor them.” If you are wise you will not hate them. But the white man said to hell with the medicines from the earth, we will make our pharmaceuticals from petroleum and condemn anyone who uses the medicine from the earth. That is how the whole medical system is set up. He did a job on us and destroyed our doctors that really knew how to do these things, so we had no other choice but to depend on him.

That does not mean throw your medication away: if your head is killing you, go take your Tylenol. Just know it is a chemical, and taking it all the time affects your kidneys, and the headache is because something else is wrong.
“My son, prove thy soul in thy life, and see what is evil for it, and give not that unto it.” Prove what your soul wants and what is evil for it, the things you should not be eating or consuming.

“For all things are not profitable for all men.” Everybody can’t eat everything: some people eat chocolate and break out. “neither hath every soul pleasure in every thing”: everybody does not like the same things.

“Be not unsatiable in any dainty thing.” Do not be unsatiable in dainty things like sweets. Now Esau is coming out saying too much sugar gives you cancer; God told us not to eat too much sugar because he knows what it does to the body.

“nor too greedy upon meats.” Don’t eat too much meat. We are not supposed to be eating meat every day.

“For excess of meats bringeth sickness.” You are going to get sick if you keep eating beef and chicken every day. That’s what God says; take it or leave it. “and surfeiting will turn into choler”: excess will turn into sickness.

“By surfeiting have many perished.” By excess many people perish: too much sweets, too much meat, then you get sick and die. The Lord tells us how to deal even with food: not to have it in excess.

“but he that taketh heed prolongeth his life.” Take heed and you will live longer; you won’t die of colon cancer or get diabetes from too much sugar. Our forefathers understood these things and lived long and healthy.

precepts.why: Too much of anything is no good for you. “It is not good to eat much honey.” It ain’t good to eat too much honey, too much sugar. It is okay to have a little cheat day, but do it all the time and you are going to get sick. That’s what God says.

“A very little is sufficient for a man well nurtured, and he fetcheth not his wind short upon his bed.” A little is enough for a man who is well nurtured. Eat a little and you won’t be farting all the time lying in the bed next to your wife.

And the worst is a sister breaking wind around her husband. Sisters, there is a commandment that can never be broken, an eternal law: don’t ever fart around your husband. You are a woman; you are supposed to be roses and smelling good.

sense.text:
“Woe unto them that seek deep to hide their counsel from the Lord, and their works are in the dark.” Everything Rockefeller and all of them did is in the dark.

“and they say, Who seeth us? and who knoweth us?” Who knows we set up the whole medical industry to destroy people and to destroy the natural way for people to heal themselves? But we see them, and God sees them.

“Surely your turning of things upside down.” They turned everything upside down: the whole medical industry is turned upside down. It “shall be esteemed as the potter’s clay.”

When Christ returns there will be no more Tylenol, none of the crap they use today, no more pharmaceuticals, no more petroleum chemicals. The whole medical practice of today will be done, and the Lord will turn everything back the way it is supposed to be.
